text:
Type: children's storage combination with bench
Use: storing clothes and toys, sitting on the bench chest; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board, flat fronts with cut-out finger grips

Shape: wide grouping of a tall six-drawer chest, a low storage bench chest and a tall two-door wardrobe over three drawers, rectangular cut-out handles, clean flat fronts, large but simple visual weight
